content: Android Chrome grants installed/home-screen PWAs an autoplay-with-sound exemption within manifest scope; muted autoplay is always allowed. This app never attempts true autoplay (every sound is tap-triggered), so the exemption is reassuring but not load-bearing -- the same synchronous-tap pattern used for iOS is safe and sufficient cross-platform. WebView apps can independently opt in/out of the autoplay policy via API. Sources: Chrome for Developers autoplay policy blog, Chromium blink-dev Intent-to-Ship thread.
